verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a dedicated 'Individual targeting' capability. Its docs state you can target individuals, segments, or specific devices in addition to attributes, and you can even set expiration dates on targeting, which suits time-boxed beta testers. A community user corroborates that non-engineers use its targeting to control who gets features. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of excluding specific individuals (deny-list behavior) in the pack, independent hands-on corroboration of per-individual targeting rather than rule/group-level targeting.
